camel_example: aliyun dms ListAgenticGlobalSqlExecutionHistories --region cn-hangzhou --ActorType HUMAN --EndTime '2026-06-01_00:00:00' --CatalogUuid 'mc-HZ-OfjcNc2z000' --Size 20 --DatabaseUuid 'md-HZ-fp9K7r000' --StartTime '2026-01-01_00:00:00' --Page 1 --SqlKeyword SELECT --SqlType SELECT --ActorId usr_10001 --ActorName 'demo-user' --Scenario AGENT_QUERY --version 2025-04-14 --method POST --force
description_en: Queries the SQL execution history within the current tenant and returns the results in descending order of execution start time. Only AGENT_QUERY and WORKFLOW_QUERY are included
description_zh: 查询当前租户内的 SQL 执行历史，按执行开始时间倒序返回。只包含 AGENT_QUERY 和 WORKFLOW_QUERY
name: ListAgenticGlobalSqlExecutionHistories

parameters.help_en: The catalog UUID for exact match. You can obtain this value by calling ListAgenticCatalog or SearchAgenticCatalog
parameters.help_zh: Catalog UUID，精确匹配。可通过 ListAgenticCatalog 或 SearchAgenticCatalog 获取
parameters.name: catalog_uuid

parameters.help_en: The database UUID for exact match. You can obtain this value by calling ListAgenticDatabase or SearchAgenticDatabase
parameters.help_zh: Database UUID，精确匹配。可通过 ListAgenticDatabase 或 SearchAgenticDatabase 获取
parameters.name: database_uuid

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，从 1 开始。不传时默认为 1
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页条数。不传时默认为 20，最大为 100
parameters.name: size

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format. If you do not specify this parameter, the default time range is the last 7 days. If the specified time is earlier than 730 days ago or the format cannot be parsed, the query starts from 730 days ago
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss。不传时默认最近 7 天。早于 730 天或格式无法解析时，按 730 天前查询
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format. If you do not specify this parameter, the default end time is the current time. If the format cannot be parsed or the end time is earlier than the start time, the request fails
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss。不传时默认到当前时间。格式无法解析，或早于开始时间时，请求失败
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The keyword for fuzzy match based on the original SQL statement
parameters.help_zh: 按原始 SQL 模糊匹配的关键字
parameters.name: sql_keyword

parameters.help_en: The SQL type for exact match
parameters.name: sql_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the actor. A user ID starts with usr_, and an agent ID starts with agt_. If you do not specify this parameter, all records within the current tenant are queried. If you specify a user ID, the records of the user and the agents under the user are included. If you specify an agent ID, only the records of the agent are matched. The actor must belong to the current tenant
parameters.help_zh: 执行者 ID。用户以 usr_ 开头，Agent 以 agt_ 开头。不传时查询当前租户内全部记录。传入用户 ID 时包含该用户及其名下 Agent；传入 Agent ID 时只匹配该 Agent。必须属于当前租户
parameters.name: actor_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the actor for exact match
parameters.name: actor_name

parameters.help_en: The type of the actor for exact match. Valid values: HUMAN and AGENT
parameters.help_zh: 执行者类型，精确匹配。取值为 HUMAN 或 AGENT
parameters.name: actor_type

parameters.help_en:
The execution scenario for exact match. Valid values:
AGENT_QUERY: The agent directly executes the SQL statement.
WORKFLOW_QUERY: The SQL statement is asynchronously executed through a workflow.
If you do not specify this parameter, both scenarios are queried
parameters.help_zh: 执行场景，精确匹配。AGENT_QUERY 表示 Agent 直接执行 SQL，WORKFLOW_QUERY 表示通过 Workflow 异步执行 SQL。不传时同时查询这两种场景
parameters.name: scenario

Data.description_en: The list of SQL execution history

ActorId.description_en: The ID of the actor. A user ID starts with usr_, and an agent ID starts with agt_
ActorId.description_zh: 执行者 ID。用户以 usr_ 开头，Agent 以 agt_ 开头

ActorType.description_en: The type of the actor. A value of HUMAN indicates a user, and a value of AGENT indicates an agent
ActorType.description_zh: 执行者类型。HUMAN 表示用户，AGENT 表示 Agent

AgentOwnerId.description_en: The ID of the user to which the agent belongs. The ID starts with usr_
AgentOwnerId.description_zh: Agent 所属用户的 ID，以 usr_ 开头

CatalogUuid.description_en: The catalog UUID to which the execution belongs
CatalogUuid.description_zh: 本次执行所属的 Catalog UUID

ClientIp.description_en: The IP address of the client that initiates the execution, excluding the port. This parameter is empty in workflow scenarios or when the IP address is not recorded
ClientIp.description_zh: 发起执行的客户端 IP，不含端口。工作流场景或未记录时为空

Cost.description_en: The execution duration of the SQL statement

DatabaseSearchName.description_en: The search name of the database

DatabaseUuid.description_en: The database UUID to which the execution belongs
DatabaseUuid.description_zh: 本次执行所属的 Database UUID

Error.description_en: The error message returned when the execution fails
Error.description_zh: 执行失败时的错误信息

ExecutedSql.description_en: The actual SQL statement that is executed

ExecutionStatus.description_en:
The execution status. Valid values:
SUCCESS: The execution is successful.
FAILED: The execution fails.
BLOCKED: The execution is blocked or not actually executed
ExecutionStatus.description_zh: 执行状态。SUCCESS 表示成功，FAILED 表示失败，BLOCKED 表示被拦截或未实际执行

QueryId.description_en: The query ID of the execution

Scenario.description_en:
The execution scenario. Valid values:
AGENT_QUERY: The agent directly executes the SQL statement.
WORKFLOW_QUERY: The SQL statement is asynchronously executed through a workflow
Scenario.description_zh: 执行场景。AGENT_QUERY 表示 Agent 直接执行 SQL，WORKFLOW_QUERY 表示通过 Workflow 异步执行 SQL

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the execution. The time is in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format
StartTime.description_zh: 执行开始时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

WorkflowId.description_en: The workflow ID. This parameter may be empty in non-workflow scenarios
WorkflowId.description_zh: 工作流 ID。非工作流场景可能为空

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code. This parameter is empty when the request is successful

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时返回的错误信息
ErrorMessage.example: Invalid endTime format, expected yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:
true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。true 表示成功，false 表示失败

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries that meet the conditions
